verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents tracking personnel tasks, with reminders for policy acceptance and security awareness training completion, plus custom fields on Personnel records. That partially covers proving hires completed training. Access revocation evidence comes only from periodic user access reviews, which is an adjacent feature rather than an offboarding workflow. Missing for 10: documented HR-system sync of hires and leavers, explicit onboarding/offboarding checklists, offboarding-triggered access-removal verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, onboarding and offboarding are compliance events — HR-synced checklists prove every hire got training and every leaver lost access

citations.quote: Set up reminders for personnel to complete assigned tasks including policy acceptance and security awareness training completion
